seoTitle: Las Cruces Public Schools Calendar: LCPS Dates & PDFs
seoDescription: Reviewed Las Cruces Public Schools dates, grade-transition days, remote learning dates, breaks, graduations, and official LCPS calendar PDFs.
districtFact: Las Cruces Public Schools opens each approved calendar with a transition day for kindergarten, sixth grade, and ninth grade before the remaining grades arrive. Families also need to distinguish the main instructional calendar from the separate Arrowhead Park Early College High School and Early Childhood calendars published for 2026–27.

about.title: A Transition Day Before the Districtwide Start
about.content: LCPS gives kindergarten, sixth-grade, and ninth-grade students their own first day before grades 1–5, 7–8, and 10–12 begin. The same two-day opening pattern appears in both approved school years covered here, and the final student date is also split by those grade groups.

about.title: Arrowhead Park Uses Its Own Instructional Calendar
about.content: Arrowhead Park Early College High School is located at New Mexico State University's Arrowhead Research Park. LCPS publishes a separate APECHS calendar because the program combines high school study with access to college credit; students should use the APECHS file rather than assuming every districtwide date applies.

about.title: Early Childhood Has a Separate Schedule
about.content: LCPS Early Childhood serves eligible three- and four-year-old children through programs that include Head Start and NM PreK. The district provides a separate Early Childhood calendar in English and Spanish for 2026–27, so preschool families should not use the K–12 opening date as their default.

calendarNotes: The main LCPS instructional calendar uses a transition day for kindergarten, sixth grade, and ninth grade before all other grades begin. Those same grade groups finish one day before grades 1–5, 7–8, and 10–11. Educator Planning dates are labeled as remote learning activities, so students may have work away from the regular campus schedule. Parent-teacher conference and Next Step Planning dates are separately identified as no-school days. Cultural Awareness Week is observed while school remains in session. Arrowhead Park Early College High School and Early Childhood families should use their program-specific calendars when available. LCPS publishes the main instructional calendars in English and Spanish.

planningTips.title: Planning with the Las Cruces Public Schools Calendar
content: Use the student's grade to choose the correct first and last instructional day; LCPS does not use one opening or ending date for every grade.
Treat Educator Planning dates as remote learning activity days, not automatic vacation days, and check the school for assignment and device expectations.
Plan supervision for the August parent-teacher conference day and the February Next Step Planning/conference day because the PDF identifies both as no-school dates.
Arrowhead Park ECHS students should open the separate program calendar before booking travel or arranging college-course transportation.
Early Childhood families should use the dedicated English or Spanish Early Childhood calendar instead of the districtwide K–12 calendar.
Recheck the official LCPS calendar hub after revisions or emergency closures; a MySchoolDates download is a one-time import.

livingHere.intro: LCPS calendar planning reflects a southern New Mexico district whose programs connect neighborhood schools, early learning, and an NMSU-based early-college campus.

highlights.label: NMSU early-college connection
highlights.detail: Arrowhead Park ECHS operates at NMSU's Arrowhead Research Park and follows a separate instructional calendar.

highlights.label: Different hours by school level
highlights.detail: The official LCPS hub lists different elementary, middle, high, MVLA, Rio Grande Preparatory Institute, and Arrowhead Park ECHS hours.

highlights.label: Program-specific preschool planning
highlights.detail: Head Start and NM PreK families have a dedicated Early Childhood calendar and family handbook.

highlights.label: Six graduation ceremonies
highlights.detail: The main calendars publish two days of district graduation times for Centennial, Las Cruces, Mayfield, Organ Mountain, Arrowhead Park, and Rio Grande Preparatory Institute.

districtFaqs.q: Do all Las Cruces Public Schools students start on the same day?
districtFaqs.a: No. Kindergarten, sixth-grade, and ninth-grade students begin on a transition day. Grades 1–5, 7–8, and 10–12 begin the following school day.

districtFaqs.q: Are LCPS Educator Planning dates school holidays?
districtFaqs.a: No. The official calendars label them as Educator Planning dates with remote learning activities. Students may have schoolwork away from the regular campus day.

districtFaqs.q: Does Arrowhead Park ECHS follow the main LCPS calendar?
districtFaqs.a: LCPS publishes a separate Arrowhead Park ECHS instructional calendar for 2026–27. APECHS students should use that file and school communications for exact dates.

districtFaqs.q: Which calendar should LCPS preschool families use?
districtFaqs.a: Use the separate Early Childhood calendar when the child is enrolled in an LCPS Early Childhood, Head Start, or NM PreK program. The main calendar's K–12 dates may not match.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify Las Cruces Public Schools calendar changes?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official LCPS Calendars, Handbooks & School Hours page and messages from the student's school. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and is not affiliated with LCPS.

customSections.label: Which LCPS Calendar Applies?
customSections.content: LCPS publishes more than a translation of one district calendar. The student's school or program determines which date grid should drive family plans.

rows: Uses the K/6/9 transition day and districtwide breaks.
The NMSU-based early-college program has its own English and Spanish files for 2026–27.
Head Start, NM PreK, and other early-childhood dates may differ from the K–12 calendar.
